Principal Fr. Agnel Higher Secondary School, Pilar
Principal's Message

Welcome to Our School

“Education is not merely about acquiring knowledge; it is about discovering one's potential and using it to make a meaningful difference in the world.”

At Fr. Agnel Higher Secondary School, we believe that every student has unique talents and limitless potential. We strive to provide a supportive environment where students can learn, explore, question and grow.

Through quality education, strong values, co-curricular activities, sports and opportunities for creativity, we prepare students for a changing world while nurturing responsible and compassionate citizens.

Arts Stream

Science Stream

Compulsory Group

  • Language I: English
  • Language II: Hindi / Konkani

Stream Group

  • Physics
  • Chemistry
  • Biology

Mathematics is compulsory for XI and XII. Students may opt for Psychology in place of Mathematics.

  • P.Ed
  • Computer Education Programme
  • Environmental Education

Vocational Stream

Auto Engineering Technology

Compulsory Subjects

  • Communication Skill

  • Auto Transmission

  • C.E.P

On-the-job training: 45 days during vacation — XI Std, April to May.
